lead: Hi, I'm Alice! I'm a Mechatronics Engineering student at the University of Waterloo with a passion for hardware and controls. I love creating physical systems that solve real-world problems. I pride myself in my broad skillset, having worked in a variety of roles. I've previously worked at:
bullets: Tesla -- manufacturing testing for Cybertruck, Cybercab, and Model Y
University of Waterloo's Active & Interactive Robotics Lab -- bridging the gap between robots & humans
Apex Motion Control -- making cake decorating robots
S&C Electric -- manufacturing high-voltage switches to keep the grid on
